title: Eligible Spending Categories Across the Healthy Options Card Tiers
content:
A Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card is good only in the spending categories its own tier makes it good for. The table sets out, tier by tier, what a card of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes may be used toward.

| Card tier | Over-the-counter health items | Approved groceries | Household utility bills | Rent and housing | Transport fares | Pet food and supplies | Fitness memberships and equipment | Dental, vision and hearing costs the health plan did not pay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core | yes | no | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Select | yes | no | no | no | no | no | yes | no |
| Plus | yes | yes | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |
| Premier | yes | yes | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Dual Complete | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Chronic Care Plus | yes | yes | yes | no | yes | no | yes | yes |

The spending categories each card may be used in are these:

- Core: pharmacy and over-the-counter.
- Select: pharmacy and over-the-counter; fitness.
- Plus: pharmacy and over-the-counter; grocery and produce; fitness; dental, vision and hearing.
- Premier: pharmacy and over-the-counter; grocery and produce; transportation; pet supplies; fitness; dental, vision and hearing.
- Dual Complete: pharmacy and over-the-counter; grocery and produce; utilities; rent and housing; transportation; pet supplies; fitness; dental, vision and hearing.
- Chronic Care Plus: pharmacy and over-the-counter; grocery and produce; utilities; transportation; fitness; dental, vision and hearing.

Two distinctions worth holding. Rent and housing is eligible on the Dual Complete card alone; pet supplies are eligible on the Premier and Dual Complete cards and on no other. Over-the-counter health items are eligible on every tier.
